title: ConvertX
name: convertx
description: File converter for over a thousand formats, covering images, documents, audio, video and ebooks. Source: https://github.com/C4illin/ConvertX

env.name: HTTP_ALLOWED
env.label: Opening it over plain http?
env.description: ConvertX only sends its login cookie over HTTPS unless this is on. Switch it off once it's behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.

note: Open http://<your-host>:3000 and create your account straight away, since the first visitor gets it and sign-ups close after that. Uploads and the database live in the /app/data volume. It's a big image (LibreOffice, TeX and Calibre are all in there), so the first pull takes a while. You'll be logged out whenever the container restarts, unless you add a JWT_SECRET env var holding a long random string (openssl rand -hex 32). Docs: github.com/C4illin/ConvertX
